scope: Seven complete programs, one warmup and six rotating-order fresh-process samples per implementation. Medians and samples have 0.001 ms resolution. Native fwp uses tracing, GCC O2 and LTO off; C uses GCC O2, Rust uses -O. Compilation is excluded. text-length compares identical decimal-length calculations for i=0..1999999: fwp eliminates text; C/Rust count digits directly with checked multiplication and sums. strings peers still format. Separate O0/O2 ARC/tracing probes check results and zero managed leaf allocations after constant initialization, with allocating controls. They do not measure total allocations, RSS, peak memory or elapsed-time improvement over an earlier fwp revision. ELF .text includes layout costs; whole-file bytes include runtime and linking choices.
